summary: Jin Medical International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a change in its independent registered public accounting firm. Effective June 2, 2026, the company dismissed Audit Alliance LLP and engaged Enrome LLP as its new auditor for fiscal year ending September 30, 2026. The board approved the dismissal on June 1, 2026. No adverse opinions, disagreements, or reportable events occurred during the prior engagement. The filing serves as a routine auditor change notification, not a special situation event. No deal terms apply.
